title: Identifying the Climax of a Story
skills: identify the climax in a narrative
distinguish the climax from rising and falling action
analyze how conflict reaches its turning point
explain how the climax changes the direction of the plot
alignment_note: Reinforces how to identify the climax as the key turning point in a story where conflict reaches its highest intensity. Supports plot analysis, sequencing, narrative structure, and evidence-based explanation of how the climax redirects the story toward falling action and resolution.
